industry.why: Neutral, carried, with the evidence moved towards the tape. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): third-quarter beats were sold (Sandvik down 5%, Atlas Copco down 8%, Hiab down 12%), Danske Bank's C-J (25 October) says 'a lot is priced in' with the order strength coming from data centres the market no longer pays for, and the exception is the non-AI compounder (Hexagon, 13% organic growth); against it, offshore services and nuclear have multi-year visibility and electrical equipment is still the physical bottleneck. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: D now, C prior. The sector rows do the work: Electrical equipment, Diversified groups, Distributors, Test and measurement and Engineered components at C, Flow control and Building technology at D. Five live holdings (19.35 points of the book) sit here, judged in component 4. Counter-case for D: a tape that sells beats is a regime statement; for B: the order data remain the strongest non-AI demand read in the pack. To D on a second week of beats sold with relative strength falling to F.

sector.key: O.4. Electrical equipment, grid and automation
sector.why: Neutral, carried, with the row's own condition half fired and the row named as the one most likely to move down next. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: F now, B prior; the condition written last week was 'to D on an F reading with hyperscaler capital spending guides cut': the F reading is here, the capital-spending leg was not read this week (no strategist reached the pack), and last week's read was prints below consensus, not guides cut. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). The demand side (about 27 gigawatts of 2027 US data-centre build, Fortum's 22-year nuclear agreement, the grid as the constraint; Jefferies and Danske Bank, 28 October) is unchanged and unread. Two live holdings, Alfen (3.18%, Fitness 34.5) and Arteche (3.70%, Fitness 44.5), judged in components 4 and 5; their reviews do not depend on this letter. Counter-case for D: the market's refusal to pay for data-centre orders is now two months of relative strength, not a week; for B: the binding constraint on the largest capital-spending theme is this sector's product. To D on a second F reading or a hyperscaler guide cut read in the sources; to B if relative strength returns to C with the capital-spending read intact.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to Spain this week (a source pack is present, 2026-W43, and it carried nothing country-specific here), relative strength is not graded by country, and Richard's view is G10 and Europe-wide with no country line. An absence is an absence; no tilt.

items.criterion: Relative price more than 25% below its 52W high, read at the month-end

bullets.text: Sell signal at the 30-Oct month-end: relative price 34.7% below its 12-May-2026 52W high; 43.8% below on 10-Nov.
The whole holding (three tranches, 3.62% of capital now) sells at the Tue 17-Nov session; it was due at 3 and 10-Nov.
Ending it at the 30-Nov month-end needs relative price 33.4% higher, €35.88 at a flat market.

items.criterion: Industry RS below 30, read each Friday

bullets.text: Sell signal at the Fri 6-Nov reading: Industry RS for Industrials and capital goods 26 (46 at 30-Oct); 26 on 10-Nov.
A second whole-holding sell signal, sold at the same Tue 17-Nov session; in force until the Fri 13-Nov reading.
79 on 9-Oct, 46 on 23 and 30-Oct, 26 since 4-Nov; one step of six to seven points would cross back above 30.

items.criterion: A tranche 30% below its highest close since purchase, with Stock RS below 70

bullets.text: No sell signal: tranches 1 and 2's level is €26.39, 1.9% below the €26.9 close; tranche 3's is €22.26.
17.0% away on 29-Oct, 2.6% on 6-Nov, 1.9% on 9 and 10-Nov; Stock RS (33) is below 70.
A close at €26.39 triggers tranches 1 and 2, relevant only if you overrule the 17-Nov sale.

items.criterion: Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal at the 30-Oct reading (Stock RS 76); on 10-Nov's values both parts are present: Sector RS 17, Stock RS 33.
Stock RS fell 43 points since 30-Oct; Sector RS has been below 50 since 16-Oct, up from 4 on 4-Nov.
A sell signal at the 30-Nov month-end unless Stock RS recovers to 70 or Sector RS to 50.

items.criterion: SS Sales or SS PT Net Upgrade Breadth below zero AND Stock RS below 50, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: revenue and PT Net Upgrade Breadth +33% each; Stock RS (33) below 50 since 5-Nov.
A sell signal at 30-Nov needs two of the three analysts to cut; none has cut since the August month-end.

items.criterion: The 200D MA of relative price flat or falling over the month, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal at the 6-Nov reading: the relative 200D MA rose 2.39% over the month; 2.07% on 10-Nov.
At a flat relative price it stops rising about 21-Dec-2026; 10% lower, about 30-Nov; 20% lower, about 25-Nov.

adds.criterion: The rules: no sell signal from the six Sell Criteria

bullets.text: The rules block an add: relative price more than 25% below its 52W high (30-Oct) and Industry RS below 30 (6-Nov) both give sell signals.
Industry RS back above 30 on a Friday and relative price back inside the line at a month-end (€35.88 on 30-Nov at a flat market).

adds.criterion: The rules: room below the holding's limit

bullets.text: Arteche is 3.62% of capital (current value) against the 6.68% limit for a Middle Innings Core Investment: 3.06% of room.
The limit governs purchases only; the sell signals, not the limit, block an add.

adds.criterion: Where Arteche stands for an add: pulling back or basing; may be retesting or forming a VCP; healthily retesting or breaking out

bullets.text: None of the three: a broken trend, below all seven MAs, the August floor and the 29-Jul and 1-Sep lows, 13.4% below the absolute 200D MA.
The Master Dashboard also reads none of the three (pulling back 2 of 4 tests, basing 2 of 4, healthy retest 2 of 6, volatility contraction pattern 1 of 4).
A heavy-volume up day closing above €27.7, then a close above €29.0; 10-Nov's attempt stalled at €27.7.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a positive retest of a rising MA

bullets.text: Absent: the retest of the rising absolute 200D MA (€31.06) failed on 30-Oct; Arteche has closed below it for eight sessions, 13.4% below on 10-Nov.
No up day in the decline has reached 1.25x the 50D average; your trend-health tests fail on the SP below every MA.
A heavy-volume close back above €31.06 that holds.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a broadening of the case (momentum rising in guidance, sell-side estimates, technicals or peers)

bullets.text: Absent: no guidance since 28-Jul; estimates flat since 30-Sep; technicals falling (Stock RS 94 to 33 in a month).
Peers are mixed: the leaders' estimates and guidance rise while their multiples fall (Morgan Stanley on Legrand, 6-Nov); Pfisterer's estimates fall.
A Strategic Plan 2027-2029 (30-Nov) above consensus, or Arteche leading a sector up day on heavy volume.
On 10-Nov you wrote "As a Core Investment, it triggers the Sell Criteria" and "So, I sell", then a possible Speculative Bet of 3% of AUM.
None of that plan's four entry checks (5D and 10D MAs rising, price above the 20D MA, five-session volume) is present on 10-Nov.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
